content: {"episode_id":"ep-05159","cpt":"93271","denial_carc":"PR-204","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the PR-204 denial of CPT 93271, cardiac event monitoring, which Blue Summit Plan states is not covered under the member's current benefit plan. The clinical indication note documents a patient presenting with a history of intermittent palpitations and subjective awareness of irregular heartbeats, prompting further evaluation for suspected cardiac arrhythmia, consistent with the submitted diagnosis codes I49.9 and R00.2. Per the note, the cardiac event monitoring study is ordered to correlate these symptomatic episodes with underlying rhythm disturbances by capturing electrocardiographic data during symptom onset. On this documented clinical necessity, we request reconsideration and payment of the outstanding balance of 430.52."}
